name: w43_pers225_board
_comment: Wave 43 R16 with kits/w43_pers225.mjs (the stock përs 225 overridden into the kit person and listed in sÿst 1455's Person slots, after përs 1151 never appeared) (the deferred auto-abort): Kit Pers Slot (sÿst 1455), with no traffic and përs 1151 Kit Refuel Person in its first Person slot at 100%, so a Tab finds the person or nothing (wave 42 ran this in Kit Pers Range, sÿst 1446). Hand-driven (loops/interactive.mjs, inbox w43.jsonl; wave 43 evidence tools/r16.mjs): Tab (land and take off to re-roll the traffic until the person is there), hail, accept its LinkMission 1044 (auto-abort, ShipGoal 5, DatePostInc 7), the mission list, Tab to the special ship; {done} hands over to loops/board.mjs (the kit hulk's magenta colour, off screen its radar blip; wave 43 r16_b lost the target in bracket mode; sweep); then hand-driven again (the mission list, land, Leave). Recording from the start at 30 fps; the pilot is pulled at the end.
